Put it in docs/plan.md plus a shared Playwright helper e2e/support/responsive.ts (checks overlap / clipping / horizontal overflow of [data-part] elements at the given sizes, screenshots to <build dir>/screens/p1/<name>-<w>x<h>.png) with a self-test. 3) Write docs/plan.md 'Wave P1' and an ADR. Commit, push work-1, ff main.
